notes.meaning: True happiness begins by turning away from evil advice and harmful habits. Sin often leads people downward in steps, starting with listening to bad counsel, moving to lingering in sinful behavior, and ending in comfortable company with those who mock God. The person who belongs to God chooses a completely different direction.

differ.view: Martin Luther taught that walking in wicked counsel means following false religious doctrines and human ideas, while sitting in the seat of mockers refers to misleading teachers who take the place of God's word in the church.

notes.meaning: A faithful person finds deep joy in God's law, which means the whole instruction of Scripture. Meditating on it is not about emptying the mind, but filling it with God's truth throughout the day and night. Constant reflection on God's word guides every decision and brings comfort to the heart.

The righteous person is compared to a tree carefully planted near irrigation streams, giving it a constant source of life. It bears good fruit when the time is right, keeps its green leaves without drying up, and thrives under God's blessing. This prosperity means that God works through all our circumstances to bring about lasting spiritual good.

other.label: Modern scholarship
other.view: The streams of water refer to man-made irrigation canals common in the ancient Near East that kept cultivated trees nourished.

notes.meaning: The wicked are the exact opposite of the well-rooted tree. They are like chaff, the light and dry husks left over from grain, which the wind easily blows off the threshing floor. Because their lives lack truth and goodness, they have no real weight or stability.

Because the wicked have no firm standing with God, they will not be acquitted when God judges the world. They will have nothing to say in their defense when God separates the wheat from the chaff. When God's people are finally gathered together, those who chose rebellion will have no place among them.

The Lord personally knows, protects, and watches over the lives of those who trust Him. Their faithful walk matters to Him and will end in safety and life. By contrast, the plans and direction of the wicked will crumble and disappear into ruin.
